name: Logon/Logoff Activity
description: Successful and failed logons, logoffs, explicit-credential logons, session reconnects and disconnects, workstation lock and unlock, and logons denied by policy. Use the Logon type column to tell interactive, network, service and RDP logons apart.
author: EventHawk (Microsoft documentation, SANS, Sigma)
